reviews.comment:
Muy lindo lugar para parar a cargar combustible y los servicios en condiciones de higiene. Dato interesante si seguís al cruce del río Colorado y es de día, hace calor y se tiene algo de tiempo... hay un balneario con arboleda , mesas para almorzar y esta a orillas de la ruta y del río, habilitado para darse un chapuzón.

(Translated by Google)
A very nice place to stop for fuel, and the facilities are clean. An interesting tip: if you continue past the Colorado River crossing and it's daytime, warm, and you have some time... there's a riverside resort with trees, picnic tables, and it's right on the side of the road and the river, perfect for a swim.

Muy mala predisposición ...te dicen mire las flechas para cargar combustible y si hay 10 autos en un solo surtidor no te dicen pase por acá parece que mientras menos gente tengan en su isla mejor osea que trabaje el compañero .

(Translated by Google)
Very poor attitude... they tell you to look at the arrows to refuel, and if there are 10 cars at a single pump they don't tell you to go this way; it seems that the fewer people they have at their island, the better, meaning that the other guy should do his job.
